Role overview :
We are seeking a highly skilled
Java Engineer
to join our team in support of a major financial client. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in building scalable, secure, and high-performance applications using
Java
,
Spring
and
Spring Boot
frameworks. Familiarity with
Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)
Agile development methodologies
is essential.
You will be working on mission-critical systems that support financial operations, contributing to both greenfield development and modernization of legacy systems.
Key Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.
• Implement and advocate for Event-Driven Architecture and microservices-based solutions.
• Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to iterative software delivery.
• Write clean, scalable, and testable code following best practices and coding standards.
• Troubleshoot, debug, and enhance existing systems to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
• Work closely with DevOps and QA teams to streamline CI/CD and testing pipelines.
Required Skills & Experience:
• 5+ years of hands-on experience with
(preferably Java 11 or newer).

(including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, etc.).

• Solid understanding and practical experience with
Event-Driven Architecture
and messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ).
• Familiarity with
RESTful APIs
, microservices, and distributed systems.
• Experience working in an
Agile/Scrum
environment.
• Knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
• Exposure to DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.

financial services industry
or other regulated environments.
cloud platforms

• Understanding of security best practices and compliance standards in financial systems.
Why Join Us?
• Opportunity to work with a global leader in financial services.
• Cutting-edge projects with modern tech stacks.
• Supportive and collaborative work environment.
• Opportunities for growth and professional development.

Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
